images.title: Half turn and quarter turns on the giant wheel
images.purpose: Show a seat on the giant wheel taking 1 half turn and then 2 quarter turns in the same direction and coming back to the starting seat E.
images.composition: A large wheel on the left with three curved arrows round it, and the sum written large on the right.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. WHEEL, centre (470, 410): a rim circle 440 px across (thin dark #2B2B2B outline, 5 px), exactly 8 thin grey #6B7280 spokes from the hub to the rim (one every 45 steps of the circle, the first straight up), a hub circle 40 px across. On the rim exactly 8 small rounded seats, 40 px wide, at the end of each spoke: the seat at the top is amber #E69F00 and carries the letter E above it (40 px, bold, dark); the other 7 seats are pale grey. A support (two thin dark lines) from the hub down to the ground line y 690. ARROWS: three curved arrows on a circle of 290 px radius outside the rim, all going clockwise, each with an arrowhead: the first teal #0072B2 from the top to the bottom down the right side (a half turn); the second amber #E69F00 from the bottom to the left (a quarter turn); the third amber from the left back to the top (a quarter turn). Labels beside the arrows in dark #1F2937 sans-serif (34 px): 1 half turn at x 820, y 410 beside the first arrow; quarter turn 1 at x 120, y 640 beside the second; quarter turn 2 at x 120, y 190 beside the third. RIGHT SIDE: three lines of dark bold text (60 px) left aligned at x 900: 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/4 at y 330, = 1 full turn at y 420, and, smaller (40 px) at y 520, back at E. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
more or fewer than 8 spokes, 8 seats or 3 arrows
a number written anywhere other than in the listed labels
images.takeaway: 1 half turn and 2 quarter turns in the same direction make a full turn: the seat is back at E.
images.description: A giant wheel with its top seat marked E and three curved arrows, a half turn and two quarter turns, that bring the seat back to E, with 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/4 = 1 full turn written beside it.
images.context: Concept image for Halves and Quarters Make a Full Turn. It follows the idea of the giant wheel in your maths book (a full turn when it comes back to the starting position E) and shows the concept's own example of 1 half turn and 2 quarter turns.
images.teaching_notes: Follow the seat from E with a finger, a half turn first and then two quarter turns. The slip to watch is counting the half turn as one quarter turn.

image_decisions.why: The wheel with its three arrows shows the half turn and the two quarter turns joining into one full turn back at E.
